segments.text: Voice box is a desktop app for voice cloning and speech synthesis. Feed it a few seconds of audio and it clones the voice using models like Quen 3TS. Then
you arrange the generated speech on a timeline. Drag clips around, layer different voices, edit the output like you would in a DAW. Includes Whisper for
transcription so you can edit based on the actual text. Runs locally. No cloud processing. No subscription.
